mapper.select: select * from nad_application_decision where application_id = #{applicationId} order by decided_at desc
mapper.insert: insert into nad_application_decision (application_id, decision_type, outcome, rationale, drives_transition_code, decided_by, decided_at) values (#{applicationId}, #{decisionType}, #{outcome}, #{rationale}, #{drivesTransitionCode}, #{decidedBy}, now())
